newsitem.title: USA: McKesson says unit sells Aqua-Vend division.
newsitem.headline: McKesson says unit sells Aqua-Vend division.

text.p: McKesson Corp said on Monday its water products unit, McKesson Water Products Co, had sold substantially all of the assets of its Aqua-Vend division to Glacier Water Services Inc.
Separately, Glacier Water said the purchase price was $9 million and the consideration was paid in cash.
The decision to sell the Aqua-Vend division was made in order to sharpen McKesson Water Products' focus on its fastest growing segments - direct delivery and grocery products, McKesson said.

McKesson Water Products Co is a bottled drinking water company which markets under the Sparkletts, Alhambra, Crystal and Aqua-Vend brands in California, Arizona, Nevada, Texas, Washington State and Florida.
